description: STM32F405 flight controller, ICM-42688-P gyro, SPL06-001 baro, AT7456E OSD, 16M blackbox flash, 6 UARTs, 8 DShot motor outputs, 5 V 3 A and 10/12 V 2.5 A BECs, DJI O4 socket, 2-6S input, 30.5 x 30.5 mm. Betaflight target MATEKF405TE.

metadata.weight_note: 7.7±0.1 g excluding accessories (manual); product page says 8 g

params.description: VBAT pad / BAT pin of the ESC socket — FC supply input, 6~30V (2~6S LiPo); also the VBAT ADC.
GND / G — ground (several pads and every socket's G pin).
5V — 5V 3A BEC output: 5V pads (edge, beside LEDS, beside SDA), camera socket 5V pin, LED strip 5V.
10V — high-voltage BEC output (2.5 A) for VTX / DJI air unit: 10V pad, VTX socket 10V, DJI socket 10V.

params.resolution: Project decision (2026-09-26): nominal 10 V per the board silkscreen and wiring diagram, range 10-12 V kept because the manual/product page state 12 V and the selection mechanism is undocumented. Both ends are within the DJI O4 input (3.7-13.2 V); measure the rail on the physical unit.

params.note: Manual p5-6: a VTX on/off switch is mapped to the USER2 mode (Betaflight PINIO2); when not triggered the VTX is unpowered. Product page: 'BEC switch to slow down VTX heating'. If unused, set the USER2 channel threshold to the maximum.

params.description: 4.5V — supply on the receiver (RC) and GPS sockets and two 4.5V pads.

params.resolution: modelled as 4.5-5 V; current limit not stated.

params.assumption: Not stated by DolphinRC. The 4.5 V receiver/GPS rail is taken to branch from the 5 V BEC through a diode, as on the Matek F405-TE design this board's Betaflight target (MATEKF405TE) comes from; its loads are budgeted against the 5 V 3 A BEC.

params.description: M1 — motor 1 ESC signal output; pad and ESC socket pin.
M2 — motor 2 ESC signal output; pad and ESC socket pin.
M3 — motor 3 ESC signal output; pad and ESC socket pin.
M4 — motor 4 ESC signal output; pad and ESC socket pin.
M5 — motor 5 ESC signal output pad.
M6 — motor 6 ESC signal output pad.
M7 — motor 7 ESC signal output pad.
M8 — motor 8 ESC signal output pad.
CUR — current-sensor ADC input (pad and ESC socket pin). Betaflight default current meter scale 150.

params.note: Connect to the DolphinRC AM32 ESC with the included 50 mm SH 1.0 mm 8-pin cable. VOID pin is unused (no ESC telemetry line).

ESC socket, SH 1.0 mm 8-pin (included 50 mm SH 1.0 mm 8-pin cable). Wire labels BAT GND CUR VOID M1 M2 M3 M4 (manual p4). The same nets are also solder pads VBAT GND M1 M2 M3 M4 and CUR (manual p3). Pin 1 not marked; order from the BAT end.

params.reason: Pin 1 is not marked in any source; order taken from the BAT end so the FC and ESC parts share one pinout (the included cable is 1:1).

params.note: Receiver socket, silkscreen 'G 4.5V RX6 TX6'; wiring diagram labels TX6 RX6 5V GND (receiver TX -> RX6, RX -> TX6). SH 1.0 mm 4-pin cables are included. Pin 1 not marked.

params.reason: Pin 1 is not marked in any source; positions follow the silkscreen order printed beside the socket.

params.note: GPS socket, silkscreen 'G 4.5V RX4 TX4'; wiring diagram labels GND 5V RX4 TX4 (GPS TX -> RX4, GPS RX -> TX4). No I2C on this socket, so a GPS with a compass is wired to pads. Pin 1 not marked (dot beside G).

params.reason: Pin 1 is not marked in any source; positions follow the silkscreen order printed beside the socket.

params.note: Analog VTX socket, silkscreen 'G 10V VTX T5'; T5 goes to the VTX IRC pin. Pin 1 not marked (dot beside G).

params.reason: Pin 1 is not marked in any source; positions follow the silkscreen order printed beside the socket.

params.note: DJI O4 Air Unit socket, silkscreen '10V G T5 R5 G Sbus'; the included 150 mm DJI 6-pin cable maps to O4 10V GND RX TX GND SBUS. Connector series/pitch not stated. Pin 1 not marked.

params.reason: Pin 1 is not marked in any source; positions follow the silkscreen order printed beside the socket.

params.note: Camera socket, silkscreen 'C1 5V G'; included 150 mm 3-pin analog camera cable. Series not stated beyond the 3-pin cable. Pin 1 not marked.

params.reason: Pin 1 is not marked in any source; positions follow the silkscreen order printed beside the socket.

params.description: RX1 — UART1 receive pad.
TX1 — UART1 transmit pad.

params.note: UART1: RX1/TX1 pads.

params.description: RX2 — UART2 receive pad.
TX2 — UART2 transmit pad.

params.note: UART2: RX2/TX2 pads. The MATEKF405TE target defaults serial RX to UART2 and maps PPM to the UART2 RX pin.

params.description: RX3 — UART3 receive pad ('ppm' is also printed near this pad; not claimed).
TX3 — UART3 transmit pad.

params.note: UART3: RX3/TX3 pads.

params.description: RX4 — UART4 receive; pad and GPS socket.
TX4 — UART4 transmit; pad and GPS socket.

params.note: UART4: GPS socket 'G 4.5V RX4 TX4' and RX4/TX4 pads; manual wiring diagram shows a GPS here.

params.description: R5 — UART5 receive, on the DJI socket only.
TX5 / T5 — UART5 transmit: TX5 pad, VTX socket T5 (to VTX IRC), DJI socket T5.

params.note: UART5: DJI O4 Air Unit link (DJI socket T5/R5) and analog VTX control (VTX socket T5 -> VTX IRC).

params.description: RX6 — UART6 receive on the receiver socket (wire to receiver TX).
TX6 — UART6 transmit on the receiver socket (wire to receiver RX).

params.note: UART6: Receiver socket 'G 4.5V RX6 TX6'; manual wiring diagram shows the RC receiver here.

params.description: SBUS — SBUS input pad; also the 'Sbus' pin of the DJI socket (O4 SBUS output).
SDA — I2C data pad.
SCL — I2C clock pad.

params.note: I2C1 (target I2C1: SCL PB8, SDA PB7); on-board barometer and external magnetometer use I2C1. Default 400 kHz is the builder default, not a source value.

params.description: S1 — PWM output pad (product page: 10x PWM outputs, 8x DShot).
S2 — PWM output pad (product page: 10x PWM outputs, 8x DShot).
LEDS — WS2812 LED strip data output (wired to LED strip 'LED').
BZ+ — buzzer positive; wire to buzzer BZ+.

params.note: Buzzer pair; protocol 'custom' (no buzzer vocabulary). Betaflight target sets BEEPER_INVERTED.

params.description: BZ- — buzzer negative; wire to buzzer BZ-.

params.note: Buzzer pair; protocol 'custom' (no buzzer vocabulary). Betaflight target sets BEEPER_INVERTED.

params.description: C1 — camera 1 video input (pad and camera socket 'C1 5V G').

params.note: Analog composite video; protocol 'custom' (no video vocabulary, see gaps.json). OSD: AT7456E.

params.description: C2 — camera 2 video input pad (switchable dual camera; USER1 mode selects camera 2).

params.note: Analog composite video; protocol 'custom' (no video vocabulary, see gaps.json). OSD: AT7456E.

params.description: VTX — video output to the analog VTX (pad and VTX socket).

params.note: Analog composite video; protocol 'custom' (no video vocabulary, see gaps.json). OSD: AT7456E.
USB Interface: Type-C (manual). Configuration and DFU flashing; boot button beside it (review).

params.description: USB Type-C port for configuration and firmware flashing.

params.note: Hole: 30.5*30.5mm / Φ4mm (manual). M3*8mm rubber grommets for the FC are included (product page).

params.description: Four Φ4 mm corner mounting holes, 30.5 x 30.5 mm pattern.

name: DolphinRC F405 V3 Flight Controller
part_number: DolphinRC F405 V3 (F405 V3 stack, SKU DPDZ00041 option 'F405-FC')

params.note: Flash Betaflight target MATEKF405TE. With bidirectional DShot (RPM filtering) on this F405, use DShot300 and at most 4K/4K loop time; DShot600 without bidirectional DShot.
Camera switch: USER1 mode (PINIO1) — untriggered shows camera 1, triggered shows camera 2. VTX power: USER2 mode (PINIO2).
6x UARTs plus 1x Softserial_Tx option (INAV/BF).

params.resolution: Hardware per manual; whether the target build detects the SPL06-001 is not stated.

params.reason: No source states the 4.5 V rail's current limit or what feeds it; assumed from the MATEKF405TE target design so the GPS load can be budgeted. The data gap on the rail's own limit stays open.
params.value: branch of bec_5v (5 V 3 A) via a diode

params.note: Not stated by any source.
